decisionsTitle: «Clasament» lists every time «Cronometrare» recorded for a number, and «Folosește» makes one of them the line's (amending §986 and §808)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-20:** «For regular runners, if we submit a big [bib] multiple times we track history and in the end we can choose what time to display.» §986 had left it undone — «Choosing a duplicate's time with one press on «Clasament» — the history shows both, the line is typed by hand.» A number pressed twice at «Cronometrare» kept its first time on its row and the second only in «Istoricul sosirilor», a fold of the newest four hundred writes: to show the second, an organizer found it there, read it, and typed it into the line's «Timp».

**Decision — the times recorded at the line, under each line's «Timp».** For every line of «Clasament» — a registered runner's or one typed by hand, elite or not — the times «Cronometrare» recorded for the number the line is listed under since the race's last «Resetează clasamentul» (§997): the first press (`event_result.created` with `finishLine`), a press that turned a runner written off into «Sosit» (`event_result.updated` with `finishLine`) and every later press of the number (`event_result.finish_duplicate`); a press undone at the line (`event_result.deleted` with `undo`) is left out — it takes back the latest standing press of its number and time, which by the undo's own rule nobody pressed after it. Each time once, with who pressed it first and when, in the order pressed. A «Clasament» save, an import and «Folosește» itself write no `finishLine`, so what a person typed or chose is never a time recorded at the line; a delete on «Clasament» is no undo. A pure function of the trail rows (`results/domain/recorded-times.ts`, unit-tested), read with the page's data in one query of the race's trail — `audit_logs_entity_idx`, the presses' `finishLine` rows and the resets, joined to `staff_users` (`results/recorded-times.ts`) — never one query per line. When a line has more than one distinct recorded time, or its «Timp» is not its one recorded time (typed otherwise, or a line written off, deleted or with no «Sosit»), a short block under «Timp», inside its cell: «Timpi la sosire:», each time with «nume, la 09:45:20» («cont șters» for an account gone), «în clasament» on the one the line shows now, and beside every other one a 44-pixel «Folosește». One recorded time equal to the line's «Timp», or none, draws nothing.

**Decision — «Folosește» makes that time the line's.** The button posts the page's one hidden form, as «Șterge» does (`choose-recorded-time`, `choice=<number>:<milliseconds>`), with the page's fingerprint, and asks first — one question per button: «Pui 0:45:17 ca timp pentru #102 Bia Marin? Rezultatul devine «Sosit», cu timpul cip și nota de acum, iar locurile se recalculează. Ce n-ai salvat pe pagină se pierde: salvează întâi.» A small form posts only itself, and the page comes back drawn from what is stored: whatever was typed on the page and not saved is not sent, and is gone — as after «Șterge», whose question now says the same sentence, true of it all along (the e2e types a note on another line, presses «Folosește», and finds the box empty and nothing saved; «Șterge» was walked the same way).

The server is a function of its own, `results.ts#chooseRecordedFinishTime`, not `saveEventResults` with one row: the save is the whole list — a row left out is a result deleted — and reads every box as typed, while this verb changes two columns of one row and must read what the save never reads, the trail. It asserts `canEnterResults` (FORBIDDEN otherwise) and a race (`RESULTS_NOT_OPEN`); refuses with CONFLICT a page whose fingerprint is not the stored rows' (as the big save); reads the trail inside its transaction, under the event row's lock every press takes, and refuses a time that is not one recorded for that number since the last reset (`RESULT_TIME_NOT_RECORDED`, a new code); finds the line the page draws for the number — a registered runner's, else a typed row's; NOT_FOUND for none — and sets its gun time to the time chosen and its state to «Sosit», the chip time and the note untouched; a registered runner whose result was deleted on «Clasament» gets it back, «Sosit» at that time. Every place is ranked again as a save ranks them (`writeRanking`); one audit row, `event_result.updated` (`.created` for a result made again) with `{ bibNumber, status, gunTimeMs, chipTimeMs, changed, chosenFromHistory: true }` — `changed` the box `time`, and `status` when it moved —, never a name, which «Istoricul sosirilor» says as «a ales pentru #102 Bia Marin timpul 0:45:17 dintre cele înregistrate» / “chose 0:45:17 for #102 Bia Marin from the recorded times”; the public cache is told after the commit. A time that is the line's «Sosit» time already writes nothing. Through, the page comes back at the line (`#result-line-102`) with the toast «#102: timpul ales e acum în clasament, iar locurile s-au recalculat.»; refused, at the page's alert (`?timeError=<code>#results-alert`), its CONFLICT in words of its own — «Timpul nu s-a schimbat: între timp altcineva a salvat clasamentul…» —, never the reset's.

**Unchanged.** «Cronometrare»: the first press stays, a later press is a duplicate in the trail. The published results' layout. Who may enter results (`canEnterResults`). The undo at the line, the big save, the import.

**Refused.** `saveEventResults` with one posted row, for the reasons above. Choosing at «Cronometrare» — the line records, «Clasament» decides, as §986 chose. A table or a column of recorded times — the trail already holds every press with its author and its moment, and a migration would only copy it. Offering a time typed or imported on «Clasament» — the button restores what the line recorded; a typed time is in «Istoricul sosirilor». One query per line — a race has a few hundred.
changelogLine: - **«Clasament» offers every time «Cronometrare» recorded for a number** — under a line's «Timp», «Timpi la sosire» lists each time its number was pressed, with who pressed it and when, and «Folosește» makes one of them the line's time after a question; the places follow and «Istoricul sosirilor» says who chose it. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a race's «Clasament», when a line's number was pressed at «Cronometrare» more than once since the last «Resetează clasamentul», or its one recorded time is not the line's «Timp», then under that line's «Timp» — a registered runner's or a runner typed by hand, elite or not — a block «Timpi la sosire:» / “Times at the finish:” lists each time recorded for the number once, in the order first pressed, with who pressed it and when («cont șters» for an account gone), «în clasament» on the line's own and a 44-pixel «Folosește» beside each other one; a press undone at the line and everything before the last reset are left out, another number's presses and the times typed on «Clasament» are never listed, the times are read with the page's data in one query of the race's trail, and a line with one recorded time equal to its «Timp», or none, draws nothing (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/recorded-times.test.ts`, integration `results/recorded-times.test.ts`, e2e `race-results-recorded-times.spec.ts`.

Given «Timpi la sosire» on a line of «Clasament», when an Organizer or an Administrator presses «Folosește» beside a time and confirms the question that names the time and the runner and says that what is not saved on the page is lost, then the page's one hidden form posts the line's number, the time and the page's fingerprint, and the server sets that line's gun time to it and its state to «Sosit» — the chip time and the note untouched, a registered runner's result deleted on «Clasament» made again —, ranks every place again, writes one `event_result.updated` (or `.created`) audit row with the boxes changed and `chosenFromHistory: true` and no name, which «Istoricul sosirilor» says as «a ales pentru #<number> <name> timpul <time> dintre cele înregistrate», tells the public cache and comes back at the line with the toast; a page whose fingerprint is older than the stored rows is refused CONFLICT, a time not recorded for that number since the last reset `RESULT_TIME_NOT_RECORDED`, and the Tehnic role, the Redactor, the desk Volunteer and a member FORBIDDEN, each writing nothing and said at the page's alert; a time that is the line's already writes nothing (2026-11-20, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN). Verification: unit `results/finish-history.test.ts`, integration `results/recorded-times.test.ts`, e2e `race-results-recorded-times.spec.ts`.

batchLine: «Clasament» offers every time «Cronometrare» recorded for a number, «Folosește» choosing one
